title: PlayHills
description: PlayHills.eu is a mini-game server. You can play everything from PvP to Skyblock using blocks. Collect coins to gain advantages. The server is professionally managed and constantly optimized.
body:
# Skyblock
Using few materials, build a huge floating island high in the sky. Play with your friends and keep playing until you unlock the final level. You start on a small island made up of just a few blocks. Build a cobblestone generator and start your own little SkyBlock empire!

# KnockIt / KnockbackFFA
Knock other players off the platform and become the best player in KnockIt! Buy kits and upgrades to outdo the competition! Rankings based on Kills! More than 50 different maps rotate every 10 minutes to guarantee maximum fun!

# Private Servers 
Experience epic adventures on your own free server.
You can easily install and play different maps with just a click. You have the option to adjust various settings directly in-game, quickly jump in a round with friends (e.g., a round of Varo). Alternatively, you can build your own SMP on your private server and play together with many other players from the community!
